description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise (Special Provisions) Act No. 13 of 1989 - order under Section 3 - Excise Duty w.e.f. 18.09.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty rates through a statutory order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It establishes new regulatory requirements for sugar imports/exports by specifying updated tax rates. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities but rather on the legal/regulatory changes he is enacting through his ministerial authority. The content fits Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation modifying existing tax regulations.
